name: EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays 2026
summary: The official 2026 menus, read from Disney's Foodie Guide (published Nov 12), with 98 new dishes across 20 Holiday Kitchens. Disney publishes no prices in its guides, so every price shows Coming soon until a priced menu is posted. Dish photos are Disney's own.
location_notes: Kitchen locations are Disney's own 'Location:' lines. A kitchen in a pavilion that also hosts a Food & Wine marketplace is pinned on that marketplace's pin at 'anchored' precision, and says so in `pinned_from`; Refreshment Outpost, Tangierine Café, Swirled Showcase and La Poutinerie are the same venues as in Food & Wine and reuse their pins.
Left unplaced because nothing pins them closely: kitchens on the walkways and near Disney Traders, Port of Entry and the Odyssey, the carts, Connections, Sunshine Seasons and Refreshment Station.

disney-parks-blog-2026-holidays.title: Disney Eats: Foodie Guide to EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays 2026
disney-parks-blog-2026-holidays.used_for: Every kitchen and its location, every dish and description, new-dish and Holiday Cookie Stroll marks, and the photos. Publishes no prices.

disney-parks-blog-2026-dates.title: 2026 EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays Dates and Details
disney-parks-blog-2026-dates.used_for: 2026 dates (Nov 27 - Dec 30). Holiday Kitchens and the Cookie Stroll return; no booth or menu detail.

disney-parks-blog-2025.title: Disney Eats: EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays Foodie Guide 2025
disney-parks-blog-2025.used_for: The first pass of this festival, before the 2026 guide was published. Replaced by the 2026 guide; kept as a fallback photo source.

next_step: When priced menus are posted, add the prices in the Studio (the Assistant's Import a menu can read a priced page). A dish with a price drops its 'Coming soon' by itself.
photo_pages_note: Read by `epcot-fw festival photos`. The 2026 photos are already attached, straight from the guide's own cards.
price_note: Prices: none published yet. Dishes carry price_note 'Coming soon' until a priced menu is posted (WDWNT and BlogMickey post them around opening). Add each price in the Studio, or ask for the import.
